plugins.name: session-meter
plugins.description: Live session pane (/ctx): context breakdown, usage limits with pace, tool calls and model requests; a one-time note to the model when limits or context cross a threshold

plugins.name: turn-footer
plugins.description: Turns the line under each answer into a turn summary (tools, requests, tokens, cache hit) and shows the running tool in the spinner

plugins.name: change-ledger
plugins.description: A pane (/changes) listing the files this session edited with line counts and who edited them, beside the git working tree

plugins.name: turn-timeline
plugins.description: A pane (/timeline) drawing the current turn as a timeline: model requests and tool calls per loop, where the time went, and the slowest steps

plugins.name: compact-keeper
plugins.description: Saves each compaction's summary, with the files edited before it, to ~/.claude/handoffs so the context before /compact can be recovered

plugins.name: show-me
plugins.description: Draw the mermaid diagrams of each answer as images in a pane (/show-me); needs mmdc and a kitty-graphics terminal such as Ghostty

plugins.name: secret-guard
plugins.description: Keeps secrets out of the conversation: hides API keys and private keys before the model or the transcript sees them, and blocks reads of credential files and commands that print secrets

plugins.name: cache-timer
plugins.description: Counts down to when the prompt cache expires, so you can send the next message before the whole conversation has to be cached again

plugins.name: search-meter
plugins.description: Counts the model's searches and colors each one: green found first try, yellow found after misses, red found nothing

plugins.name: loop-guard
plugins.description: Tells the model, out of the user's sight, to stop when the same call fails twice with the same error

plugins.name: image-peek
plugins.description: Shows the images you paste: thumbnails above the prompt, and larger pictures under each sent message in the chat; needs a kitty-graphics terminal such as Ghostty

plugins.name: guardrails
plugins.description: Blocks Cloudflare write commands, attribution lines in commits and PRs, and claude/ branch names

plugins.name: pin-board
plugins.description: Pin standing notes with /pin: Claude keeps following them after /compact and /clear; shown in one row above the prompt or as a counter, kept per folder with --keep

plugins.name: ci-watch
plugins.description: Watch GitHub Actions in a band above the prompt after Claude pushes, opens a PR or pushes a tag: a progress bar per run, then pass or fail; optionally flag failed scheduled workflows at start
